# Municipal Ordinance No. 04, Series of 2005

**Ordinance establishing the Pitogo Municipal Fish Port and providing guidelines for its operation and management, including rates and fees.**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the Pitogo Municipal Fish Port in Brgy. Dulong Bayan as the primary loading and unloading station for fishery products. It provides guidelines for the port's operation and management, including the imposition of rates and fees for its usage. The ordinance aims to regulate the use of the fish port and generate revenue for its operational and maintenance costs.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Title: This ordinance shall be known as "AN ORDINANCE".
2.  **Section 2.** Rationale: The [[Local Government Unit]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] entered a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with the [[Philippine Fisheries Development Authority]] (PFDA) for the sole management and operation of the [[Pitogo Municipal Fish Port]] (PMFP) in Brgy. Dulong Bayan, Pitogo, Quezon, undertaking to provide fisher folks an area for the unloading and loading of fishery products and to promote the development of the fishing industry.
3.  **Section 3.** Definition of Terms: Defines terms used in the ordinance, including Berthing Fee, Unloading Fee, Transshipment Fee, Ice Conveyance Fee, Entrance Fee, Wharfage Fee, Space/Land Rental, Accreditation Fee, and Private fishports.
4.  **Section 4.** Collection of Port Revenues: Lists the fees to be charged for operational and maintenance costs, including:
    *   Unloading fee: P 0.25/kg
    *   Market fee: P 0.25/kg
    *   Transshipment fee: P 0.25/kg
    *   Ice Conveyance fee: P 1.00/block
    *   Entrance/Parking Fee: P 200.00 (Heavy vehicle 10 wheeler), P 100.00 (Heavy vehicle 6 wheeler), P 25.00 (Light vehicles Jeep/car), P 5.00 (Tricycle), P 3.00 (Pushcart)
    *   Berthing Fee: P 15.00/unit/docking (Commercial vessel), P 100.00/unit/day (Municipal Vessel), P 50.00/unit/docking (Municipal Vessel)
    *   Space Rentals: P 100.00/sq.m/mo. (Stalls), P 70.00/sq.m/mo. (Land Rental), P 150.00/day (Net Repair Area Fee), P 4.50/container (Water Fee), 1% of gross sale (Fuel Conveyance Fee)
    *   Accreditation Fee: P 100.00/clients/year
    *   Wharfage Fee: P 1.00/sack (Rice/Corn/Sugar), P 1.00/sack (Fruits/vegetable and spices, copra, palay, etc.), P 1.00/sack (Sweet Potato/Cassava), P 0.50/bag/regular (Cement), P 0.50/sack (Fertilizer/Feeds), P 0.50/case (Soft drinks), P 1.00/case (Beer/Hard Drinks)
    *   Scrap & Heavy material: 1% of declared value
    *   Livestock: 1% of declared value
5.  **Section 5.** The [[Pitogo Municipal Fish Port]] shall be used by commercial fishing vessels without prejudice to other fishing vessels who wish to avail of the fish port facilities.
6.  **Section 6.** The [[Pitogo Municipal Fish Port]] including the adjacent ports shall be solely managed and operated by the [[Local Government Unit]] (LGU) of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
7.  **Section 7.** Private Fish ports, Private Fish ports as defined under Sec. 3 (i) already operating prior to the enactment of this Ordinance may continue to operate subject to the approval of the LGU and availment of a Mayor's Permit. Private fish ports operating by virtue of the immediately preceding sentence shall be exempt from payment of fees enumerated in sec. 4 except for fees in letters (a) Unloading fees and (b) Market Fee.
8.  **Section 8.** Port Personnel - Port personnel shall be assigned upon the discretion of the [[Local Government Unit]] (LGU).
9.  **Section 9.** Operating Expenses - Only the variable operating expense shall be shouldered by the [[Pitogo Municipal Fish Port]] and the same includes but are not necessarily limited to the following: Supplies materials, Communication, Power Consumption, Water Consumption, Freight and Landing, Security Services, Utility, Traveling Expensing, Repairs and Maintenance, Reproduction, Miscellaneous Expense.
10. **Section 10.** The market checkers/collectors authorized by PMFP (LGU) shall issue tickets/stubs for every transaction undertakes and upon acknowledgement by the part clients shall collect corresponding payments for the said transaction.
11. **Section 11.** Repealing Clause. Any Ordinance rules and regulations or parts thereof, in conflict with or inconsistent with any part of this ordinance are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
12. **Section 12.** Effectivity Clause. This Ordinance shall take effect immediately after fifteen (15) days upon its approval.
